summary: Sends image, optional alpha, optional audio CHOP data, and optional metadata DAT data over IP as an NDI source for other NDI-enabled applications.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Advertise and send image data while enabled

key_params.name: failovername
key_params.note: Failover source name in MACHINENAME (SourceName) format

key_params.name: includealpha
key_params.note: Send alpha channel instead of forcing alpha to one

key_params.name: grouptable
key_params.note: Table of NDI groups this output announces

key_params.name: audiochop
key_params.note: Audio CHOP sent with the NDI stream

key_params.name: metadata
key_params.note: XML or table-format metadata sent with the stream

key_params.name: outputreferencewhite
key_params.note: default, sdr, or hdr output reference-white handling

common_gotchas: Windows firewall settings can prevent receivers from connecting.
Higher FPS can increase compression and reduce image quality.
stallmainthread may drop TouchDesigner frames, while skipframes may starve the NDI sender.
Metadata must be valid XML or table content that can be converted for NDI metadata use.
The official docs typo annouces appears near grouptable, but the parameter id is grouptable.
key_concepts: Publishes a TOP image as an NDI source on the network.
FPS guides NDI compression behavior and can affect quality versus throughput.
Low-performance behavior chooses between stalling the main thread and skipping sender frames.
The operator can send alpha, audio from an audiochop, metadata DAT content, and group membership.
Output color-space and reference-white controls describe or convert outgoing image data.
